payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the CNN model consistently outperforms other models in various tasks related to offensive content classification, making it the best performing model.

claims.text: The CNN model achieved the highest macro-F1 score of 0.80 in discriminating between offensive and non-offensive posts, outperforming the RNN model.
In a comparison of models, the CNN system outperformed the BiLSTM model with a macro-F1 score of 0.69 in identifying insults and threats.
Overall, the CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results across all sub-tasks in the study.
